title: Semi-uniform stability estimates for impedance passive systems with saturated feedback *
summary: This article investigates the long-time behavior of (possibly infinite-dimensional) impedance passive systems under saturated output feedback and external disturbances. We assume that, in the absence of saturation and disturbances, the underlying linear output feedback exponentially stabilizes the system. Our main contribution is to show that fractional Sobolev regularity of the free output is preserved by the nonlinear feedback.
